::: {.project-hook}
Built **systematick.in** — a personal platform for publishing economics and finance writing, turning ideas from research and essays into a public-facing brand.
:::

## Overview

Strong writing deserves a home. Systematick.in is where I publish economic analysis, financial commentary, and long-form essays — bridging the gap between academic research (like my SSRN paper) and accessible public discourse. It demonstrates that I don't just write; I build platforms to share ideas.

## What I Did

::: {.project-section}
<ul class="star-list">
<li><strong>Situation:</strong> I was producing economics essays and research but lacked a dedicated platform to publish and organize my work under a consistent brand.</li>
<li><strong>Task:</strong> Create a professional web presence for economics and finance content that reflects my intellectual interests.</li>
<li><strong>Action:</strong> Designed, built, and deployed systematick.in — choosing layout, typography, and content structure to serve both casual readers and academically inclined visitors.</li>
<li><strong>Result:</strong> A live publishing platform that anchors my economics/finance identity alongside my technical projects and research publications.</li>
</ul>
:::
